request: A box with a lid that holds 8 AA batteries standing up, in two rows of four across its width, with 2 mm walls.
sources: https://data.energizer.com/pdfs/E91_Max_NA.pdf (Energizer E91 AA: diameter 13.50 to 14.50 mm, height 49.50 to 50.50 mm)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AA_battery (IEC 60086 LR6: diameter 14.5 mm max, height 50.5 mm max)
note: Inside at least 4 x 14.5 by 2 x 14.5 mm, so outside w >= 58 + 2 x 2 and d >= 29 + 2 x 2. The lid's lip reaches lip_h (5 mm) into the box, so h >= floor 2 + 50.5 + 5.
